name: solboy
description: Copy trades from Solana wallets you choose. Paper trading by default.

scripts.build: npm run embed && bun build src/main.js --compile --minify --target=bun-windows-x64 --outfile dist/SolBoy-Windows.exe && bun build src/main.js --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/SolBoy-Mac-AppleSilicon && bun build src/main.js --compile --minify --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/SolBoy-Mac-Intel && bun build src/main.js --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/SolBoy-Linux-x64 && bun build src/main.js --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/SolBoy-Linux-arm64
